title: IX: The Leech

teacherSummary.text: Chillingworth settles in Boston as a physician and becomes the ailing Dimmesdale's doctor; at a hint from him, the two lodge in the same house beside the graveyard. Dimmesdale constantly presses his hand to his heart. Some townspeople begin to think the doctor's face has grown darker and that he is Satan's emissary.
